title: Day 2 of Building HOBO LIFE SIM
author: CybuhDasher
selftext:
Building a fun life simulator game about being homeless.

Today I added:

• A fun little mini hobo that voices his feelings as you try to beg for money.

• Dumpster Diving to find items to sell for a profit. Sometimes there's poop in the dumpster, try to avoid that...

• A marketplace to sell your items. It's not much money but it's something.

• Rough draft of an inventory and viewing your player stats. 

WIP - See you tomorrow!

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: I think you could make looting more interesting by making a tetris based inventory and using "extraction" game looting mechanics.  Making looting an actual gameplay loop

replies.author: CybuhDasher
replies.body: I like your thinking - I am trying to balance mechanics since this is just a mobile game, but for a full PC game extraction could be interesting. I do like the tetris based inventory. I do plan to expand the inventory later in the game, just putting all the pieces together for now. Feel free to join the discord if you want, it'll help me build the game and iterate quicker: [https://discord.gg/shVu4EKvmU](https://discord.gg/shVu4EKvmU)

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: Give it some consideration, since your game is mainly menu based, you should consider how to make the menus as engaging as possible.
